_comment: Pipeline state — the source of truth for /pipeline. Copy to state.json (gitignored by default? no: COMMIT it — the diff is the audit trail). One record per piece, keyed by type+slug. Every field below is used by a dispatcher check; nothing here is decorative.

card.task: Decide which channel to use for 200 accounts this week without legal risk
card.ownership: Our own legal review of seven channels, with statute citations
card.edge: Most teams assume B2B cold email is broadly permitted; per channel it is not

claims.text: Empty AI-engine answers are unmeasured, not uncited

pieces.note: Title 71 chars, truncates in SERPs. No new claim, so no gate 2 and no asset required.

pieces.evidence: The 90-day figure traces to no source we can name; the piece rests on it entirely.
pieces._comment: Rejected records are dedup memory. Never delete them — this is what stops the same idea returning next period. Reversible when the facts change.
Reconcile (check 0) creates records like this for anything that reached the site outside the loop, so dedup sees the real world.

meta._quota_comment: A ceiling for the approval gate, never a target for ideation. Shortfall gets reported, not padded with filler.
